snp5.9:1.1: “Those who explained (things) to me in the past,
snp5.9:1.4: saying ‘it was so, and so it will be’,
snp5.9:1.6: all that just increased my thoughts,
snp5.9:1.7: and I did not delight therein.
snp5.9:2.1: You must explain the Teaching to me,
snp5.9:2.2: O Sage, and the destruction of craving,
snp5.9:2.3: which, having understood, and living mindfully,
snp5.9:2.4: one can cross over clinging to the world.”
snp5.9:3.1: “In regard to likeable forms here seen, heard, sensed, and cognized, Hemaka,
snp5.9:3.3: the dispelling of desire and passion (for them)
snp5.9:4.1: Knowing this, those who are mindful,
snp5.9:4.2: who are Emancipated in this very life,
snp5.9:4.4: have crossed over clinging to the world.”
